import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 15;
    static final int MAX_NODE = 400;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static int[][][][] shortestPath = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] edgeCapacity = new int[MAX_NODE][MAX_NODE];
    static char[][] cellGrid = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] reactionGrid = new char[20][20];
    static int[] dr = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int iterCount = 3;
    static int[] visitedFlag = new int[MAX_NODE];

    static int dimension, T_val;

    static int dfs_augment(int cur, int dest, int bottleneck) {
        if (cur == dest) return bottleneck;
        if (visitedFlag[cur] == iterCount) return 0;
        visitedFlag[cur] = iterCount;
        for (int nxt = 0; nxt <= dest; ++nxt) {
            int result = 0;
            if (edgeCapacity[cur][nxt] > 0 && (result = dfs_augment(nxt, dest, Math.min(bottleneck, edgeCapacity[cur][nxt]))) > 0) {
                edgeCapacity[cur][nxt] -= result;
                edgeCapacity[nxt][cur] += result;
                return result;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int convert(int r, int c) {
        return (r-1) * dimension + (c-1);
    }

    static int[][] reach_arr = new int[13][13];
    static int[][] temp_arr = new int[13][13];

    static void expand_arr(int val) {
        for (int r = 0; r < 13; ++r) {
            System.arraycopy(reach_arr[r], 0, temp_arr[r], 0, 13);
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= dimension; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= dimension; ++c) {
                if (temp_arr[r][c] == val) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nr = r + dr[d];
                        int nc = c + dc[d];
                        if (nr > 0 && nc > 0 && nr <= dimension && nc <= dimension && reach_arr[nr][nc] < val && cellGrid[nr][nc] != 'Y') {
                            reach_arr[nr][nc] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean can_trace(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int infx, int infy) {
        for (int r = 0; r < 13; ++r) {
            Arrays.fill(reach_arr[r], 0);
        }
        reach_arr[sx][sy] = 1;
        reach_arr[infx][infy] = 2;
        for (int step = 0; step < 100; ++step) {
            expand_arr(1);
            if (reach_arr[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
            expand_arr(2);
            if (reach_arr[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int infx = -1, infy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_N; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < MAX_N; ++k) {
                    Arrays.fill(shortestPath[i][j][k], 0x01010101);
                }
            }
        }
        
        dimension = sc.nextInt();
        T_val = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= dimension; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            cellGrid[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
            for (int j = 1; j <= dimension; ++j) {
                shortestPath[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                if (cellGrid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i; 
                    infy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= dimension; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            reactionGrid[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= dimension; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= dimension; ++j) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int ni = i + dr[d];
                    int nj = j + dc[d];
                    if (ni > 0 && nj > 0 && ni <= dimension && nj <= dimension) {
                        if (cellGrid[i][j] != 'Y' && cellGrid[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            shortestPath[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int k = 1; k <= dimension; ++k) {
            for (int l = 1; l <= dimension; ++l) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= dimension; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 1; j <= dimension; ++j) {
                        for (int u = 1; u <= dimension; ++u) {
                            for (int v = 1; v <= dimension; ++v) {
                                shortestPath[i][j][u][v] = Math.min(shortestPath[i][j][u][v], 
                                    shortestPath[i][j][k][l] + shortestPath[k][l][u][v]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int source_node = dimension * dimension * 2 + 1;
        int sink_node = dimension * dimension * 2 + 2;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= dimension; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= dimension; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(cellGrid[i][j])) {
                    edgeCapacity[source_node][convert(i, j)] = cellGrid[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(reactionGrid[i][j])) {
                    edgeCapacity[dimension * dimension + convert(i, j)][sink_node] = reactionGrid[i][j] - '0';
                }
                
                if (Character.isDigit(cellGrid[i][j])) {
                    for (int u = 1; u <= dimension; ++u) {
                        for (int v = 1; v <= dimension; ++v) {
                            if (cellGrid[i][j] > '0' && reactionGrid[u][v] > '0') {
                                if (Character.isDigit(reactionGrid[u][v]) && shortestPath[i][j][u][v] <= T_val && can_trace(i, j, u, v, infx, infy)) {
                                    edgeCapacity[convert(i, j)][dimension * dimension + convert(u, v)] = 1000;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int total_flow = 0;
        int flow_this_round;
        while ((flow_this_round = dfs_augment(source_node, sink_node, 1000)) > 0) {
            total_flow += flow_this_round;
            ++iterCount;
        }
        
        System.out.println(total_flow);
    }
}
